messages:
maria: Quick sync — INC-912 postmortem actions consolidated. I uploaded the action list to the doc (link below). Please confirm owners and final due dates. Short list: infra rollback, alert tuning, DB index migration, QA regression, runbook paragraph + canary steps. Also PR that needs review.

raj: I'll take infra rollback. Targeting 2024-05-10 EOD. Need a maintenance window from infra-team. @alex can you confirm a time? Doc: https://redwood.example.com/incidents/INC-912/action-list

alex: I can do the maintenance window. 2024-05-10 18:00 UTC works for platform/infra. I'll open the runbook PR: https://github.com/redwood/infraplaybooks/pull/456

taylor: I'll own alert tuning. Due 2024-05-08. Will validate thresholds on staging then promote. Need `metric-service` to approve threshold changes.

emily: QA will own the regression suite. ETA 2024-05-09. Blocker: DB index migration needs to be merged before we run. Tagging @ken for the migration PR.

ken: Migration PR is up (`#7890`) but it's waiting schema-review. I can prioritize review today; if approved, target migration deploy 2024-05-07.

maria: New item — add a 1-paragraph note to the runbook about graceful fallback behavior. Who can pick this up?

raj: I can add that paragraph during rollback prep.

alex: Pinging @platform-team for GA telemetry sanity check. Also I'll coordinate the canary and fallback steps in the runbook.

taylor: Quick Q — does alert tuning require code changes or just alerting rules? If code is needed, we should route to eng-runtime.

maria: rules only, no product code. taylor please create the alert PR and add reviewers (metric-service + SRE).

emily: Once migration PR merges, QA will run the full regression. Can we get a staging snapshot on 2024-05-07 morning?

ken: Yep — I'll tag the migration deploy and post the deploy tag here as soon as it's scheduled.

oncall-bot: action item created: INC-912/AK-21 assigned to raj (infra rollback), due 2024-05-10. Link: https://tasks.redwood/inbox/AK-21

alex: I added a checklist to the runbook PR: - notify support - switch traffic 50% - monitor 15m - rollback if errors >1%.

maria: Thanks everyone. Can each owner reply with 'ack' and the final due? I'll close the RFC by EOD today.

raj: ack — infra rollback 2024-05-10 18:00 UTC

taylor: ack — alert tuning 2024-05-08 EOD

emily: ack — QA regression 2024-05-09 09:00 UTC (staging snapshot 2024-05-07 morning)

ken: ack — migration review & merge 2024-05-07 12:00 UTC

alex: ack — runbook + canary steps 2024-05-09 16:00 UTC

maria: Closing notes: if any owner hits blockers, ping this thread and @oncall. I'll follow up tomorrow to confirm everything is on track. :thumbsup:
